STEP 1 - Scene: A snack or side of roasted/baked sweet potato pieces on a white foam/paper plate, photographed from above at a slight angle, with a glass-topped surface and other items at the bottom edge (not part of this meal).

STEP 2 - Ruler: Oval white plate, roughly 22 cm long by 16 cm wide. Using ~20 cm effective diameter: area = 3.14 x 10^2 = 314 cm^2.

STEP 3 - Items: Sweet potato pieces (roasted/baked, skin on for some pieces, about 5-6 chunks), a few small yellow butter/fat bits on the plate.

STEP 4 - Area: Sweet potato pieces cover about 25% of the plate (~80 cm^2). Butter bits about 1% (~3 cm^2). Total food coverage ~26%.

STEP 5 - Volume: Sweet potato: 80 cm^2 x 2.5 cm average height = 200 ml. Butter: 3 cm^2 x 0.5 cm = 1.5 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: Sweet potato 200 ml x 0.9 (dense, bread-like cut pieces) = 180 g. Butter 1.5 ml x 0.9 = ~1.5 g (use ~2 g given visible pats).

STEP 7 - Energy: Baked sweet potato ~90 kcal/100 g: 180 g = 162 kcal. Butter ~717 kcal/100 g: 2 g = 14 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Five to six chunks of sweet potato on a ~20 cm plate, around 180 g, is plausible for a modest serving. Total ~182 g, ~176 kcal.
